title: Nuh's Plea for His Son
art: The answer comes only as light and words in the sky, never a figure. Nuh is a figure of light seen from behind.
imagePrompt: The deck of the resting wooden ship at dusk, its rail along the edge and the new washed earth stretching out far below, quiet and green with a sparkling river; seen from behind, a figure of white-gold light kneels alone at the edge of the deck looking out toward where his son was lost, his glow unsteady; a soft light descends over him from above and calligraphy writes itself gently across the evening sky; the figure lowers its head and its glow becomes calm and steady again; soft violet and gold dusk, quiet green land, parchment texture, no faces.

beats.say: At dusk, Nuh knelt at the edge of the deck, looking toward where his son was lost.

verse.en: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family…
He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous…

beats.say: Nuh lowered his head, and his light grew calm and steady again.
